question: Should OpenClaw adopt this six-family AI safety taxonomy, plugin manifest/API contract, and first-class CLI and Control UI surface as permanent core diagnostics behavior?
rationale: The linked issue already carries product- and security-decision signals, while this branch establishes broad SDK, protocol, telemetry, storage, CLI, and UI contracts that cannot safely be selected by automated review.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics first
options.body: Approve a small canonical event-contract and correctly correlated production-instrumentation phase, deferring plugin, storage, CLI, and UI contracts until the taxonomy is proven.

options.title: Adopt the full stack
options.body: Approve all proposed public surfaces while requiring loader-bound authorization, durable storage, upgrade proof, and end-to-end runtime evidence before merge.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the canonical feature issue for discussion and stop using this broad branch as a landing candidate if core ownership is not desired.

recommendation.title: Narrow to diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Approve a small canonical event-contract and correctly correlated production-instrumentation phase, deferring plugin, storage, CLI, and UI contracts until the taxonomy is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history most strongly connects this contributor to plugin manifest contracts, Gateway and CLI product surfaces, and broad core direction.
